study.title: City Memory Study 001: Montreal, Seen Again

proposal_test.scope: Three-week paid City Memory diagnostic: curate 12 source-linked Montreal archive records into one approved visual direction, with a provenance ledger, one buyer-ready concept deck, one spatial application, and one revision round.
exclusions: printing, framing, fabrication, installation, shipping, taxes, and third-party licensing fees
full interior design or construction documents
unverified historical research or legal rights clearance

privacy.storage_boundary: No names, contact details, sensitive material, raw recordings, addresses, or raw budget figures in this ledger or the GitHub issue.
privacy.recording_rule: Record only with explicit consent; store any recording in the approved private location and keep only a private reference token here.
privacy.redaction_rule: Use role category, organization type, categorical fields, and private reference tokens only; keep identifying details in the approved private system.
